body: Carried both new programme directions: rotate U3 at provider saturation rather than wait for reset; use the other providers to weekly saturation; start U4 on grok or muse and permit parallel simulations under a host budget. My standing no longer imposes blanket U4-after-U3 or single-heavy-job sequencing. Please return the named U4 seat/pool, U3 rotation owner/destination and enforceable aggregate host admission allocation owed by your orders, so I can issue corresponding bounded briefs. The quoted policy is settled; this request is for implementation details. Historical89percent and the seat’s32core/60GB observation are not current availability measurements. Existing job grants remain exact pending specific amendment; one thread per ccx eigen job, parallelism across jobs, and scientific qualification gates remain. A’s source-only PartA and B’s namespace candidate already proceed independently.
